From `action.yml` of [sassdavid/relgap-action v1.1.0](https://github.com/sassdavid/relgap-action/tree/v1.1.0).

### Inputs

| Input | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `version` |  | relgap version to install (X.Y.Z, vX.Y.Z or latest). Empty installs the version this action release pins in scripts/tool.env. |
| `verify` | `attestation` | The check after sha256 against checksums.txt. attestation runs gh attestation verify, pinned to relgap's release workflow. cosign runs cosign verify-blob on checksums.txt and needs cosign or mise on PATH. checksum adds nothing. |
| `mode` | `install` | install puts relgap on PATH. report runs the command once, writes JSON, Markdown, SARIF and annotations, uploads the SARIF and writes the step summary. comment does the same on a pull_request event and keeps one comment on the pull request. |
| `command` |  | The command that report and comment mode run. Empty runs the first one scripts/tool.env lists for the mode. |
| `args` |  | More arguments for the command, one per line. |
| `from` |  | A directory of results from an earlier step, passed with the flag that scripts/tool.env names. Only a tool that sets that flag takes it; see the README. |
| `fail-on` |  | Values for --fail-on, separated by commas or newlines. A match exits 3 and fails the step after the files, the SARIF upload and the comment. |
| `sarif` | `true` | Upload the SARIF file to code scanning (true or false). The job needs security-events write. |
| `step-summary` | `true` | Append the Markdown report to the step summary (true or false). |
| `github-token` | <code v-pre>${{ github.token }}</code> | Token for gh attestation verify, the GitHub API calls of relgap, the SARIF upload and the pull request comment. |
| `working-directory` | `.` | Directory the command runs in. SARIF locations are relative to it. |

### Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `version` | The installed relgap version, without a leading v. |
| `path` | Absolute path of the relgap binary. |
| `exit-code` | Exit code of the command in report and comment mode (0, 1, 2, 3 or 4). |
| `json-file` | Absolute path of the JSON report; empty when the command wrote none. |
| `sarif-file` | Absolute path of the SARIF file; empty when the command writes no SARIF. |
| `md-file` | Absolute path of the Markdown report; empty when the command wrote none. |
